final_report: The patient exhibits severe multi-system adverse events including Grade 4 neutropenia, Grade 3 cerebrovascular accident with residual deficits, recurrent Grade 3 anemia, and persistent gastrointestinal, electrolyte, and endocrine disturbances. These cumulative, unresolved toxicities indicate profound bone marrow suppression, irreversible end-organ damage, and metabolic decompensation, reflecting poor physiological reserve and high mortality risk.
